original_model_guards: Authorisation cannot release work; captured duplicates produce one confirmation.
Last-frame competition keeps the existing reservation and retains the late paid order.
Hold blocks production; a stale cancellation cannot erase actual printing or consumed materials.
Competing refunds cannot exceed balance; editing invalidates approval and unknown submissions remain reserved.
Uncertain booking is recovered once; handover gates dispatch and old tracking cannot regress delivery; split order remains partial.
Failed mutations restore state and keep dialog record references valid for correction.
Another tab’s newer state blocks a stale consequential edit.
Filter/session saves also cannot overwrite a newer tab; explicit scenario reset can replace sample state.
A one-item remedy cannot refund the value of two purchased units.
A stock correction after reservation cannot start printing or consume negative stock.
Later refunds invalidate the current bank comparison but retain receipt evidence; unknown fees keep expected settlement unknown.
Resolving one request leaves other cases on the same order open; reopening restores a correctly owned follow-up.
CSV exports neutralise formula-like cells and quote embedded quotes.

focused_checks.test: Fresh install: 7 sections, one owner, one order, 22 products
Complete order journey through actual forms and confirmations
Damage after delivery and canonical refund approval/unknown/verification/reporting
Profile identity check, address/history separation, tags and promotional consent
Staff, honest connection state, and scenario reset preserving staff/public storage
Encrypted private upload, verified original download, lock and wrong-passphrase rejection
New print versions keep released job pinned; approval evidence stays private
Public image revisions, unchanged originals and exact-path shared assets export excluding private files
Backup/restore round-trip, passphrase retained, corrupt backup rejected without data replacement
Draft saving, exact publish blockers, safe deletion, demo publication and pause
Mixed CSV validation and new drafts never inherit private files or approvals
Unsaved product edits protected on navigation; explicit discard leaves saved record intact
Filtered order export, follow-up ownership and saved reply tools remain reachable
All 23 isolated scenario entry points and operations-role restrictions
60 desktop, tablet and phone route renders without page-width overflow

integration.check: A1 migration preserves all existing orders, customer notes and order notes
Scenario draft does not inherit a private master or approval
